summary: Two skiers skied out of bounds below the Hero's Lift on Aspen Mountain into hazardous terrain and dialed 911 about 5:50 p.m. with inadequate clothing and gear; Mountain Rescue Aspen deployed at 6:30 p.m. via snowmobiles with extra clothing and headlamps, used drones, located the pair at 7:24 p.m. just after sunset, and completed a long difficult headlamp descent; both rescued uninjured
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen (Pitkin County Sheriff's Office)
notes: Date approximate (Saturday-verified; pinned from the article's "last updated" Tuesday 2024-03-12 + "Saturday at approximately 5:50 p.m."). Run-541 Pitkin chunk; advnture page opened this run.
